en.t: The Golden Pavilion has severed its relationship with me.

units.source_text: 我想，"这样一来，我和金阁共存在同一世界里的梦想崩溃了。

en.t: I thought, "In this way, the dream that the Golden Pavilion and I could coexist in the same world has collapsed.

units.source_text: 另外，本来就毫无指望的事态——美在那边。

en.t: Moreover, the situation that had been hopeless from the start, that beauty was over there,

units.source_text: 而我却在这边的事态——开始了。

en.t: while I was here on this side, has begun.

units.source_text: 只要这个世界还继续存在，这种事态就将不会改变……"

en.t: As long as this world continues to exist, this state of things will never change..."
